name: Feature request

**What you want to do, and why the current keys/settings do not cover it:**

**How you would expect it to behave** — especially what should happen afterwards
(advance, stay, return to the grid), since that is configurable for the existing
actions.

**Does it act on someone else?** If so, say how it should fail safe when the
target cannot be resolved. Refusing is always preferable to guessing here.
